description: Subjects whose death date is before the last visit date
columnHeading: Site, Subject, Death Date, Last Visit Date
logic: Death date is not null and the last visit date is later than the death date. Exclude deleted forms.
reportScenarios: Scenario 1 - YES: death date earlier than last visit. Scenario 2 - NO: no death date.
referenceCode: proc sql; create table out as select a.siteid, a.subjid, a.dthdt, b.lastvis from dm a join sv b on a.usubjid=b.usubjid where a.dthdt < b.lastvis; quit;
